nodes.label: Release Workflow (skopeo retagging)
nodes.rationale: Release does not rebuild. It uses skopeo to copy the already-built short-SHA images to version tags, preserving multi-arch manifests, and only applies the :stable tag when the git tag matches a plain vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH pattern so beta tags never become stable.

edges.source_location: for variant in standard-arm64 tensorrt tensorrt-jp6 rk rocm synaptics
release retags ghcr.io/<repo>:${GITHUB_SHA::7}-<variant> images that ci.yml pushed under the same short-SHA tag scheme
duplicates the lowercaseRepo + 7-char SHORT_SHA tag construction that setup/action.yml emits as outputs
